corrections.why: The FFLOS record describes a 50 ft wooden tower, about 15.2 m. The 4.3 m in our record matches no tower height in the sources read.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and the Weebly summary say removed in June 2007; firelookout.com says destroyed. The Weebly summary gives the reason as unsafe for occupancy, so the story uses removed.
The 2007 Oregon chapter report says flat cab; FFLOS and firelookout.com say ODF live-in cab. These can describe the same cab, so both are recorded.

sources.title: Forest Fire Lookout Association Oregon Chapter report, 2007

notes_for_editor: WebSearch was unavailable for this run (the shared search budget was spent before this tower), so nothing about the site today was checked beyond the four pages read. The brief's height_m of 4.3 looks wrong; a 50 ft tower is about 15.2 m. The brief's FFLOS registration date (March 26, 2011) did not appear in the page text read here, so no fflos_registered event is recorded. The 1938 and 1955 details are quoted second-hand from Douglas FPA and ODF annual reports on the Weebly page; those reports were not opened. The camera-system replacement is recorded as a plan only.
